label: Counted Cross Stitch
blurb: Works the picture as counted cross stitch on an open weave cloth. The frame is squared off into a grid, each square gets one colour taken from the picture there and is worked as two crossed strokes of thread, the under stroke shaded where the over stroke lies across it. The thread is round and catches the light along its length, the bare cloth shows between the stitches with its own warp and weft, and the palette can be cut down to a set number of thread colours the way a real pattern is, so neighbouring squares share a shade.
